en: Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia view down a cobblestone street lined with multi‑storey townhouses on both sides. A few pedestrians, including a child, walk along the right sidewalk. In the distance, towers of a church or town building rise above the roofs. At the top of the image, red printed text identifies the location as Kamenz in Saxony and the specific street as Kirchstraße.
